lines.text: Watch the Professor when I say 'Mrs. Rudd'. ...There. Did you hear that?
You sitting in Friday?
Somebody cut.
He's dropped a note.
I always sit in Friday.
Look what the wind blew in.
Earl takes a dollar off you every time he deals.
He mends her organ Sundays and eats in the kitchen for it.
Bet two bits more'n it's worth.
That's nobody's business but theirs.
Three. Don't spare me.
He do. I watch for how. Three year, and I've not caught him at it yet.
Ah, sure. I wouldn't say it to him.
I'll bet.
Call.
Two pair, eights and fours. Read 'em out loud, boys, if you can.
What come of your saddle, anyhow?
Stole. In Tascosa.
Ain't no sheriff tonight, boys!
That's hard. Man can't hire on without one.
Ask me about something else, Earl.
Five-card. Same as ever.
I'm sorry. I'm sorry, I only... It's your deal.
To the last one. And the next.
Check.
Three. And make 'em good.
A dollar.
Obliged.
That's your grass the Baron's wire goes round, down by the ford?
Cut 'em thin, deal 'em true.
Four shoes I owe Stroud for. Since August.
I'll knock.
It was mine. I sold him the low meadow in 'seventy-six. He paid what I asked, in gold, the same day.
Has he asked?
Then you've no quarrel with him.
He ain't said ary word. Stands there looking at his iron.
Pay him, Hiram.
Funny how it goes, Earl.
A pair of nines. Now ain't that something.
No. Only the creek below it, it used to come up to my knee. Now it's here. My ankle.
I mean to pay him! That ain't what I'm telling you.
God damn it, Rufe, set it down like you paid for it!
That's the dry years, maybe.
I did pay for it!
Come on, come on. Ante.
You paid for the whiskey. Them glasses come up from Denver in straw, and half of 'em don't come.
One.
I've throwed better glasses than that at a mule! In Santa Fe, this was, the mule had got into...
I'll see that.
Thirty-one dollars, Rufe.
Two pair, queens and threes. Clean deck, boys. Clean as Sunday.
Cut 'em where I can see, Earl.
Now, Wiley. Have I ever...
Twice last night. I let it go by.
Well. Well, there, you cut them. Go on. Cut them yourself.
Let's see if these are any kinder.
Bet.
Don't mind if I do.
Night, all.
Night.
You're a lucky old man, Earl.
A pair of twos. Don't look at me like that.
Is Wiley eating, Hiram?
Deal's mine. Watch my hands, if you like.
There's bread goes missing off the feed bin. I ain't looked into it.
You leave it there for him.
Professor wants a tuner up from Denver. Twelve dollars and his fare.
See you.
I set it down and forget it. I'm an old man. Leave me be.
Help you, mister?
The C sticks. I've heard it stick.
Nobody? Then that's mine.
Ante up. You know the price.
Three, and quit smiling.
Fold.
Nobody wants it? I'll mind it for you.
Baron's outfit's hiring. Sixty a month.
Sixty! For riding?
They don't ask can you rope.
What do they ask?
I come away before he got to it.
These cards have been against me since Christmas.
Kitty! Come sit by a man that's been somewhere.
